intent: Write the test for IntakeService (context telemetry-ingestion-processing) at the test file path; the unit under test lives at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/intake/application/IntakeService.java. Assert only against the tabled surface. Telemetry Intake entry owner with zero blocking I/O. receive stamps tIngress (current instant) on every sample via withIngress and offers each to its own bounded Sinks.many().multicast().onBackpressureBuffer(bufferCapacity, false) sink (capacity from TelemetryProperties); a refused offer (on_false) is dropped and counted telemetry.pipeline.dropped tag stage=intake, an accepted offer (on_true) counts toward the returned accepted total. Counter telemetry.intake.packets tag outcome=accepted when every sample was accepted, outcome=overflow otherwise. Audit entry (actor device, action ingest, outcome accepted or overflow, correlationId of the first sample) written through AuditTrail. stream exposes the sink as the Flux consumed by the pipeline. observability.step_logs: intake.packet.received (via the StepLog instance method emit once per packet). observability.step_logs = ["intake.packet.received"] TEST DUTIES: Assert tIngress is stamped, accepted count, empty list gives 0, stream emits the offered samples, overflow with capacity exhausted yields outcome=overflow and dropped{stage=intake}, audit entry fields and the step name.

methods.signature: IntakeService(TelemetryProperties properties, AuditTrail auditTrail, StepLog stepLog, MeterRegistry meterRegistry)

methods.semantics: refused offer: counted in telemetry.pipeline.dropped{stage=intake} and packet outcome=overflow
